name: Tohru in der Schreiberei

menus.name: seasonal tasting menu
menus.note: Fish and meat; wine, sake and non-alcoholic pairings offered (prices not published); allergies and dietary needs on request when booking

alsoTry.name: Bar Tatar
alsoTry.note: The bar in the same building, the Schreiberei; open Tuesday to Friday from 5pm and Saturday from 1pm, booking recommended but not required

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. New tables are released every Monday, three months ahead. Tables for four may still be free when those for two are gone.
cancellation: Cancellations less than 48 hours before, and no-shows, may be charged €450 per person.
groups: Groups of more than six and up to 35 people book by email (kontakt@schreiberei-muc.de).
duration: About three and a half hours.
